dialogue.text: It's 1989, and we are generating and storing more digital information than ever before.
dialogue.zh: 現在是1989年，我們產生並儲存的數位資訊比以往任何時候都多。
dialogue.ja: 1989年、私たちはこれまでにないほど多くのデジタル情報を生成し、保存しています。
dialogue.local: It's 1989, and we are generating and storing more digital information than ever before.
dialogue.en: It's 1989, and we are generating and storing more digital information than ever before.

dialogue.text: The problem is, how do we easily share it?
dialogue.zh: 問題是，我們如何輕鬆分享這些資訊？
dialogue.ja: 問題は、それをどうやって簡単に共有するかです。
dialogue.local: The problem is, how do we easily share it?
dialogue.en: The problem is, how do we easily share it?

dialogue.text: The solution will rapidly and fundamentally change our lives.
dialogue.zh: 這個解決方案將迅速且根本地改變我們的生活。
dialogue.ja: その解決策は、私たちの生活を急速かつ根本的に変えるでしょう。
dialogue.local: The solution will rapidly and fundamentally change our lives.
dialogue.en: The solution will rapidly and fundamentally change our lives.

dialogue.text: I'm Indy Neidell, this is a time-ghost short.
dialogue.zh: 我是Indy Neidell，這是time-ghost短片。
dialogue.ja: 私はインディ・ナイデルです。これはタイムゴーストのショート動画です。
dialogue.local: I'm Indy Neidell, this is a time-ghost short.
dialogue.en: I'm Indy Neidell, this is a time-ghost short.

dialogue.text: Okay, 1989 at the headquarters of the European Organization for Nuclear Research,
dialogue.zh: 好了，1989年，在歐洲核子研究組織的總部，
dialogue.ja: さて、1989年、欧州原子核研究機構の本部で、
dialogue.local: Okay, 1989 at the headquarters of the European Organization for Nuclear Research,
dialogue.en: Okay, 1989 at the headquarters of the European Organization for Nuclear Research,

dialogue.text: San in Geneva, Switzerland.
dialogue.zh: 位於瑞士日內瓦的桑恩。
dialogue.ja: スイスのジュネーブにあるサンです。
dialogue.local: San in Geneva, Switzerland.
dialogue.en: San in Geneva, Switzerland.

dialogue.text: A young British software engineer named Tim Berners-Lee
dialogue.zh: 一位名叫提姆·伯納斯-李的年輕英國軟體工程師
dialogue.ja: ティム・バーナーズ＝リーという若いイギリス人ソフトウェアエンジニアが、
dialogue.local: A young British software engineer named Tim Berners-Lee
dialogue.en: A young British software engineer named Tim Berners-Lee

dialogue.text: is increasingly frustrated with a difficulty of sharing information
dialogue.zh: 對於分享資訊的困難越來越感到挫折，
dialogue.ja: 情報共有の難しさにますます苛立っています。
dialogue.local: is increasingly frustrated with a difficulty of sharing information
dialogue.en: is increasingly frustrated with a difficulty of sharing information

dialogue.text: between the organization's computers.
dialogue.zh: 在組織內部的電腦之間。
dialogue.ja: 組織内のコンピュータ間でのことです。
dialogue.local: between the organization's computers.
dialogue.en: between the organization's computers.

dialogue.text: See, Saren has many different models of computer,
dialogue.zh: 你看，桑恩有許多不同型號的電腦，
dialogue.ja: 実は、サンには様々なモデルのコンピュータがあり、
dialogue.local: See, Saren has many different models of computer,
dialogue.en: See, Saren has many different models of computer,

dialogue.text: running different operating systems with constant compatibility issues.
dialogue.zh: 運行著不同的作業系統，經常有相容性問題。
dialogue.ja: 異なるオペレーティングシステムを動かしていて、常に互換性の問題があります。
dialogue.local: running different operating systems with constant compatibility issues.
dialogue.en: running different operating systems with constant compatibility issues.

dialogue.text: He believes he has the solution.
dialogue.zh: 他相信自己有解決方案。
dialogue.ja: 彼は解決策を持っていると信じています。
dialogue.local: He believes he has the solution.
dialogue.en: He believes he has the solution.

dialogue.text: Inspired by the web of relationships, gossip, and newsletters
dialogue.zh: 他受到人際關係網、八卦和通訊的啟發，
dialogue.ja: 人間関係の網や噂話、ニュースレターに触発されて、
dialogue.local: Inspired by the web of relationships, gossip, and newsletters
dialogue.en: Inspired by the web of relationships, gossip, and newsletters

dialogue.text: by which information is shared in the physical world that Saren,
dialogue.zh: 在現實世界中資訊是如何被分享的，桑恩，
dialogue.ja: 現実世界で情報が共有される方法に着想を得て、サンは、
dialogue.local: by which information is shared in the physical world that Saren,
dialogue.en: by which information is shared in the physical world that Saren,

dialogue.text: he imagines a universal network of virtual documents,
dialogue.zh: 他想像出一個普遍的虛擬文件網路，
dialogue.ja: 彼は仮想文書の普遍的なネットワークを想像しました。
dialogue.local: he imagines a universal network of virtual documents,
dialogue.en: he imagines a universal network of virtual documents,

dialogue.text: which all computer users can access, edit, and add to.
dialogue.zh: 所有電腦使用者都能存取、編輯並新增內容。
dialogue.ja: すべてのコンピュータユーザーがアクセスし、編集し、追加できるものです。
dialogue.local: which all computer users can access, edit, and add to.
dialogue.en: which all computer users can access, edit, and add to.

dialogue.text: Documents would be made up of hypertext, text containing hyperlinks,
dialogue.zh: 文件將由超文本組成，包含超連結的文字，
dialogue.ja: 文書はハイパーテキスト、つまりハイパーリンクを含むテキストで構成されます。
dialogue.local: Documents would be made up of hypertext, text containing hyperlinks,
dialogue.en: Documents would be made up of hypertext, text containing hyperlinks,

dialogue.text: so users can navigate from page to page.
dialogue.zh: 讓使用者能從一頁導航到另一頁。
dialogue.ja: ユーザーがページ間を移動できるようにするためです。
dialogue.local: so users can navigate from page to page.
dialogue.en: so users can navigate from page to page.

dialogue.text: He writes the initial proposal in March 1989, and in summer 1990,
dialogue.zh: 他在1989年3月寫下初步提案，並在1990年夏天，
dialogue.ja: 彼は1989年3月に最初の提案を書き、1990年の夏には、
dialogue.local: He writes the initial proposal in March 1989, and in summer 1990,
dialogue.en: He writes the initial proposal in March 1989, and in summer 1990,

dialogue.text: settles on a name that reflects his ambitions, the World Wide Web.
dialogue.zh: 定下了反映他抱負的名稱——萬維網。
dialogue.ja: 彼の野望を反映した名前、ワールド・ワイド・ウェブに決めました。
dialogue.local: settles on a name that reflects his ambitions, the World Wide Web.
dialogue.en: settles on a name that reflects his ambitions, the World Wide Web.

dialogue.text: With backing from Saren, he begins coding in October 1990 on a next computer.
dialogue.zh: 在桑恩的支持下，他於1990年10月開始在一台NeXT電腦上編碼。
dialogue.ja: サンの支援を受けて、1990年10月にNeXTコンピュータでコーディングを始めました。
dialogue.local: With backing from Saren, he begins coding in October 1990 on a next computer.
dialogue.en: With backing from Saren, he begins coding in October 1990 on a next computer.

dialogue.text: Over the next few months, he writes code for the web,
dialogue.zh: 接下來幾個月，他撰寫了網頁的程式碼，
dialogue.ja: その後数ヶ月で、彼はウェブのコードを書き、
dialogue.local: Over the next few months, he writes code for the web,
dialogue.en: Over the next few months, he writes code for the web,

dialogue.text: and the first browser, which allows navigation and viewing of pages.
dialogue.zh: 以及第一個瀏覽器，讓使用者能瀏覽和查看網頁。
dialogue.ja: ページの閲覧とナビゲーションを可能にする最初のブラウザも作りました。
dialogue.local: and the first browser, which allows navigation and viewing of pages.
dialogue.en: and the first browser, which allows navigation and viewing of pages.

dialogue.text: His computer becomes the first server,
dialogue.zh: 他的電腦成為第一台伺服器，
dialogue.ja: 彼のコンピュータは最初のサーバーになり、
dialogue.local: His computer becomes the first server,
dialogue.en: His computer becomes the first server,

dialogue.text: storing and delivering pages to users.
dialogue.zh: 儲存並傳送網頁給使用者。
dialogue.ja: ユーザーにページを保存し、配信します。
dialogue.local: storing and delivering pages to users.
dialogue.en: storing and delivering pages to users.

dialogue.text: By Christmas Day 1990, the web is up and running.
dialogue.zh: 到了1990年聖誕節，網路已經運作起來了。
dialogue.ja: 1990年のクリスマスまでに、ウェブは稼働を始めました。
dialogue.local: By Christmas Day 1990, the web is up and running.
dialogue.en: By Christmas Day 1990, the web is up and running.

dialogue.text: So crucial is the little next computer that it has a note stuck to it.
dialogue.zh: 這台小小的NeXT電腦非常重要，上面貼著一張便條。
dialogue.ja: その小さなNeXTコンピュータは非常に重要で、メモが貼られていました。
dialogue.local: So crucial is the little next computer that it has a note stuck to it.
dialogue.en: So crucial is the little next computer that it has a note stuck to it.

dialogue.text: This machine is a server. Do not power it down.
dialogue.zh: 這台機器是伺服器，請勿關機。
dialogue.ja: この機械はサーバーです。電源を切らないでください。
dialogue.local: This machine is a server. Do not power it down.
dialogue.en: This machine is a server. Do not power it down.

dialogue.text: Berners-Lee has helped from colleagues at Saren,
dialogue.zh: 伯納斯-李獲得了桑恩同事的協助，
dialogue.ja: バーナーズ＝リーはサンの同僚たちの助けを得て、
dialogue.local: Berners-Lee has helped from colleagues at Saren,
dialogue.en: Berners-Lee has helped from colleagues at Saren,

dialogue.text: but in 1991, invites outside contributors.
dialogue.zh: 但在1991年，他邀請外部貢獻者參與。
dialogue.ja: しかし1991年には外部の貢献者も招きました。
dialogue.local: but in 1991, invites outside contributors.
dialogue.en: but in 1991, invites outside contributors.

dialogue.text: Over the next two years, the web grows as word spreads.
dialogue.zh: 接下來兩年，隨著消息傳開，網路逐漸成長。
dialogue.ja: その後の2年間で、口コミでウェブは成長しました。
dialogue.local: Over the next two years, the web grows as word spreads.
dialogue.en: Over the next two years, the web grows as word spreads.

dialogue.text: For now, it's mainly limited to a community of academics, students, and enthusiasts.
dialogue.zh: 目前主要限於學者、學生和愛好者的社群。
dialogue.ja: 今のところ、主に学者や学生、熱心な人々のコミュニティに限られています。
dialogue.local: For now, it's mainly limited to a community of academics, students, and enthusiasts.
dialogue.en: For now, it's mainly limited to a community of academics, students, and enthusiasts.

dialogue.text: I mean, in 1990, just 15% of American households own a computer.
dialogue.zh: 也就是說，1990年只有15%的美國家庭擁有電腦。
dialogue.ja: つまり、1990年にはアメリカの家庭のわずか15％がコンピュータを所有していました。
dialogue.local: I mean, in 1990, just 15% of American households own a computer.
dialogue.en: I mean, in 1990, just 15% of American households own a computer.

dialogue.text: His goals are idealistic.
dialogue.zh: 他的目標很理想主義。
dialogue.ja: 彼の目標は理想主義的です。
dialogue.local: His goals are idealistic.
dialogue.en: His goals are idealistic.

dialogue.text: In April 1993, he releases the code for free,
dialogue.zh: 1993年4月，他免費釋出程式碼，
dialogue.ja: 1993年4月、彼はコードを無料で公開しました。
dialogue.local: In April 1993, he releases the code for free,
dialogue.en: In April 1993, he releases the code for free,

dialogue.text: and later writes he has no regrets over not cashing in.
dialogue.zh: 並且後來寫道，他不後悔沒有從中獲利。
dialogue.ja: そして後に、利益を得なかったことを後悔していないと書いています。
dialogue.local: and later writes he has no regrets over not cashing in.
dialogue.en: and later writes he has no regrets over not cashing in.

dialogue.text: You can't propose that something be a universal space,
dialogue.zh: 你不能提議某物成為一個普遍空間，
dialogue.ja: 何かを普遍的な空間にすると提案しながら、
dialogue.local: You can't propose that something be a universal space,
dialogue.en: You can't propose that something be a universal space,

dialogue.text: and at the same time, keep control of it.
dialogue.zh: 卻同時控制它。
dialogue.ja: 同時にそれをコントロールし続けることはできません。
dialogue.local: and at the same time, keep control of it.
dialogue.en: and at the same time, keep control of it.

dialogue.text: Others are keen to cash in, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過其他人則熱衷於從中獲利。
dialogue.ja: しかし他の人たちは利益を得ることに熱心です。
dialogue.local: Others are keen to cash in, though.
dialogue.en: Others are keen to cash in, though.

dialogue.text: Two new browsers are released.
dialogue.zh: 兩款新瀏覽器被推出。
dialogue.ja: 2つの新しいブラウザがリリースされました。
dialogue.local: Two new browsers are released.
dialogue.en: Two new browsers are released.

dialogue.text: Mosaic and September 93, a navigator in December 94.
dialogue.zh: 分別是1993年9月的Mosaic和1994年12月的Navigator。
dialogue.ja: 1993年9月のモザイクと、1994年12月のナビゲーターです。
dialogue.local: Mosaic and September 93, a navigator in December 94.
dialogue.en: Mosaic and September 93, a navigator in December 94.

dialogue.text: They are the first to display images, audio, and video files along with text,
dialogue.zh: 它們是第一批能同時顯示圖片、音訊和影片檔案與文字的瀏覽器，
dialogue.ja: これらはテキストとともに画像、音声、動画ファイルを表示する最初のブラウザです。
dialogue.local: They are the first to display images, audio, and video files along with text,
dialogue.en: They are the first to display images, audio, and video files along with text,

dialogue.text: rather than just opening new windows.
dialogue.zh: 而不是僅僅開啟新視窗。
dialogue.ja: 単に新しいウィンドウを開くだけではありません。
dialogue.local: rather than just opening new windows.
dialogue.en: rather than just opening new windows.

dialogue.text: And this user-friendliness attracts a new audience.
dialogue.zh: 這種使用者友善性吸引了新的使用者群。
dialogue.ja: この使いやすさが新しいユーザーを引きつけました。
dialogue.local: And this user-friendliness attracts a new audience.
dialogue.en: And this user-friendliness attracts a new audience.

dialogue.text: Despite Mosaic's head start, it is quickly crushed by navigator,
dialogue.zh: 儘管Mosaic先行一步，但很快被Navigator擊敗，
dialogue.ja: モザイクが先行しましたが、ナビゲーターにすぐに圧倒されました。
dialogue.local: Despite Mosaic's head start, it is quickly crushed by navigator,
dialogue.en: Despite Mosaic's head start, it is quickly crushed by navigator,

dialogue.text: which is a much faster program, securing 75% market share in just four months.
dialogue.zh: 因為它是更快的程式，僅四個月就取得了75%的市佔率。
dialogue.ja: ナビゲーターははるかに高速なプログラムで、わずか4ヶ月で75％の市場シェアを獲得しました。
dialogue.local: which is a much faster program, securing 75% market share in just four months.
dialogue.en: which is a much faster program, securing 75% market share in just four months.

dialogue.text: Boyed by success, navigator's parent company Netscape
dialogue.zh: 受到成功鼓舞，Navigator的母公司Netscape
dialogue.ja: 成功に気を良くしたナビゲーターの親会社、ネットスケープは、
dialogue.local: Boyed by success, navigator's parent company Netscape
dialogue.en: Boyed by success, navigator's parent company Netscape

dialogue.text: wants to list itself on the stock market with an initial public offering IPO.
dialogue.zh: 想透過首次公開募股（IPO）上市。
dialogue.ja: 株式公開（IPO）で株式市場に上場しようとしました。
dialogue.local: wants to list itself on the stock market with an initial public offering IPO.
dialogue.en: wants to list itself on the stock market with an initial public offering IPO.

dialogue.text: Now, as a rule of thumb, companies need a year of profits
dialogue.zh: 一般來說，公司需要一年的獲利紀錄，
dialogue.ja: 一般的に、企業はIPOの前に1年分の利益が必要です。
dialogue.local: Now, as a rule of thumb, companies need a year of profits
dialogue.en: Now, as a rule of thumb, companies need a year of profits

dialogue.text: before investors will buy into an IPO,
dialogue.zh: 投資人才會願意購買IPO股票，
dialogue.ja: 投資家がIPOに参加するためには、
dialogue.local: before investors will buy into an IPO,
dialogue.en: before investors will buy into an IPO,

dialogue.text: and Netscape has never turned a profit.
dialogue.zh: 而Netscape從未獲利過。
dialogue.ja: しかしネットスケープは一度も利益を出したことがありません。
dialogue.local: and Netscape has never turned a profit.
dialogue.en: and Netscape has never turned a profit.

dialogue.text: But institutions and retail investors are keen to buy shares anyway.
dialogue.zh: 但機構和散戶投資者仍熱衷於購買股票。
dialogue.ja: それでも機関投資家や個人投資家は株を買いたがりました。
dialogue.local: But institutions and retail investors are keen to buy shares anyway.
dialogue.en: But institutions and retail investors are keen to buy shares anyway.

dialogue.text: On August 9, 1995, Netscape shares open at $28.
dialogue.zh: 1995年8月9日，Netscape股票以28美元開盤。
dialogue.ja: 1995年8月9日、ネットスケープの株は28ドルで始まりました。
dialogue.local: On August 9, 1995, Netscape shares open at $28.
dialogue.en: On August 9, 1995, Netscape shares open at $28.

dialogue.text: By the close of trading, they have more than doubled to $58.25.
dialogue.zh: 收盤時股價已超過翻倍，達到58.25美元。
dialogue.ja: 取引終了時には58.25ドルと2倍以上になりました。
dialogue.local: By the close of trading, they have more than doubled to $58.25.
dialogue.en: By the close of trading, they have more than doubled to $58.25.

dialogue.text: Netscape success heralds the .com boom.
dialogue.zh: Netscape的成功預示著.com熱潮的來臨。
dialogue.ja: ネットスケープの成功はドットコムブームの到来を告げました。
dialogue.local: Netscape success heralds the .com boom.
dialogue.en: Netscape success heralds the .com boom.

dialogue.text: As investors go crazy, the financial times write today after IPO,
dialogue.zh: 當投資者瘋狂時，《金融時報》寫道，IPO後的今天，
dialogue.ja: 投資家が熱狂する中、ファイナンシャル・タイムズはIPO後の今日をこう書きました。
dialogue.local: As investors go crazy, the financial times write today after IPO,
dialogue.en: As investors go crazy, the financial times write today after IPO,

dialogue.text: few people know how to make money from the internet,
dialogue.zh: 很少有人知道如何從網路賺錢，
dialogue.ja: インターネットでどうやってお金を稼ぐか知っている人はほとんどいませんが、
dialogue.local: few people know how to make money from the internet,
dialogue.en: few people know how to make money from the internet,

dialogue.text: but almost everybody wants a part of it.
dialogue.zh: 但幾乎每個人都想分一杯羹。
dialogue.ja: ほとんどの人がその一部を欲しがっています。
dialogue.local: but almost everybody wants a part of it.
dialogue.en: but almost everybody wants a part of it.

dialogue.text: Companies and startups vibe for consumer attention.
dialogue.zh: 公司和新創企業爭取消費者的注意力。
dialogue.ja: 企業やスタートアップは消費者の注目を集めようとしています。
dialogue.local: Companies and startups vibe for consumer attention.
dialogue.en: Companies and startups vibe for consumer attention.

dialogue.text: You want to buy a secondhand book or CD?
dialogue.zh: 你想買二手書或CD嗎？
dialogue.ja: 中古の本やCDを買いたいですか？
dialogue.local: You want to buy a secondhand book or CD?
dialogue.en: You want to buy a secondhand book or CD?

dialogue.text: Head over to eBay or Amazon.
dialogue.zh: 去eBay或Amazon看看吧。
dialogue.ja: eBayやAmazonに行ってみてください。
dialogue.local: Head over to eBay or Amazon.
dialogue.en: Head over to eBay or Amazon.

dialogue.text: Fancy a snack delivered to your door.
dialogue.zh: 想要零食送到家門口嗎？
dialogue.ja: おやつを家まで届けてもらいたいですか？
dialogue.local: Fancy a snack delivered to your door.
dialogue.en: Fancy a snack delivered to your door.

dialogue.text: Order from web van.
dialogue.zh: 從Webvan訂購吧。
dialogue.ja: Webvanから注文しましょう。
dialogue.local: Order from web van.
dialogue.en: Order from web van.

dialogue.text: If your dog or cat is hungry too, visit pets.com.
dialogue.zh: 如果你的狗或貓也餓了，拜訪pets.com。
dialogue.ja: 犬や猫もお腹が空いているなら、pets.comを訪れてください。
dialogue.local: If your dog or cat is hungry too, visit pets.com.
dialogue.en: If your dog or cat is hungry too, visit pets.com.

dialogue.text: Want to arrange lunch with a friend?
dialogue.zh: 想和朋友約午餐嗎？
dialogue.ja: 友達とランチの約束をしたいですか？
dialogue.local: Want to arrange lunch with a friend?
dialogue.en: Want to arrange lunch with a friend?

dialogue.text: No need to call her email.
dialogue.zh: 不需要打電話，發電子郵件就行。
dialogue.ja: 電話をかける必要はありません、メールで済みます。
dialogue.local: No need to call her email.
dialogue.en: No need to call her email.

dialogue.text: Sign up and chat at theglobe.com.
dialogue.zh: 在theglobe.com註冊並聊天。
dialogue.ja: theglobe.comに登録してチャットしましょう。
dialogue.local: Sign up and chat at theglobe.com.
dialogue.en: Sign up and chat at theglobe.com.

dialogue.text: Computer ownership rockets to 51% of American homes by 2000,
dialogue.zh: 到2000年，美國家庭的電腦擁有率飆升至51%。
dialogue.ja: 2000年までに、アメリカの家庭の51％がコンピュータを所有するようになりました。
dialogue.local: Computer ownership rockets to 51% of American homes by 2000,
dialogue.en: Computer ownership rockets to 51% of American homes by 2000,

dialogue.text: as the web becomes a destination for shopping, entertainment, and socializing.
dialogue.zh: 網路成為購物、娛樂和社交的目的地。
dialogue.ja: ウェブは買い物、娯楽、社交の場となりました。
dialogue.local: as the web becomes a destination for shopping, entertainment, and socializing.
dialogue.en: as the web becomes a destination for shopping, entertainment, and socializing.

dialogue.text: Berners Lee and company set out to create a free and accessible information sharing network,
dialogue.zh: 伯納斯-李和團隊著手創建一個免費且可及的資訊分享網路，
dialogue.ja: バーナーズ＝リーと仲間たちは、無料でアクセス可能な情報共有ネットワークを作ろうとしました。
dialogue.local: Berners Lee and company set out to create a free and accessible information sharing network,
dialogue.en: Berners Lee and company set out to create a free and accessible information sharing network,

dialogue.text: and they succeed it.
dialogue.zh: 他們成功了。
dialogue.ja: そして彼らはそれを成功させました。
dialogue.local: and they succeed it.
dialogue.en: and they succeed it.

dialogue.text: Though I don't think anyone imagined how all pervasive the internet and the web would become.
dialogue.zh: 雖然我想沒有人能想像網際網路和網路會變得如此普及。
dialogue.ja: しかし、インターネットとウェブがこれほどまでに普及するとは誰も想像していなかったでしょう。
dialogue.local: Though I don't think anyone imagined how all pervasive the internet and the web would become.
dialogue.en: Though I don't think anyone imagined how all pervasive the internet and the web would become.

dialogue.text: By now, it is undeniably one of the very backbones of our entire civilization,
dialogue.zh: 如今，它無疑是我們整個文明的支柱之一，
dialogue.ja: 今やそれは間違いなく私たちの文明の基盤の一つです。
dialogue.local: By now, it is undeniably one of the very backbones of our entire civilization,
dialogue.en: By now, it is undeniably one of the very backbones of our entire civilization,

dialogue.text: and for better or for worse, we are data in the information age.
dialogue.zh: 無論好壞，我們都是資訊時代的數據。
dialogue.ja: 良くも悪くも、私たちは情報時代のデータそのものです。
dialogue.local: and for better or for worse, we are data in the information age.
dialogue.en: and for better or for worse, we are data in the information age.

dialogue.text: All of our historical productions are, of course,
dialogue.zh: 我們所有的歷史產物當然是，
dialogue.ja: 私たちの歴史的な成果はもちろん、
dialogue.local: All of our historical productions are, of course,
dialogue.en: All of our historical productions are, of course,

dialogue.text: sources of information on the past to benefit the future,
dialogue.zh: 過去的資訊來源，有益於未來，
dialogue.ja: 過去に関する情報源であり、未来のために役立ちます。
dialogue.local: sources of information on the past to benefit the future,
dialogue.en: sources of information on the past to benefit the future,

dialogue.text: and to help us make ever more productions,
dialogue.zh: 並幫助我們創造更多成果，
dialogue.ja: そして、さらに多くの成果を生み出す手助けをします。
dialogue.local: and to help us make ever more productions,
dialogue.en: and to help us make ever more productions,

dialogue.text: join the timeghostarmy at timeghost.tv or patreon.com.
dialogue.zh: 加入timeghostarmy，網址是timeghost.tv或patreon.com。
dialogue.ja: timeghost.tvやpatreon.comでタイムゴーストアーミーに参加してください。
dialogue.local: join the timeghostarmy at timeghost.tv or patreon.com.
dialogue.en: join the timeghostarmy at timeghost.tv or patreon.com.

dialogue.text: Do not forget to subscribe.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了訂閱。
dialogue.ja: チャンネル登録をお忘れなく。
dialogue.local: Do not forget to subscribe.
dialogue.en: Do not forget to subscribe.

dialogue.text: See you next time.
dialogue.zh: 下次見。
dialogue.ja: また次回お会いしましょう。
dialogue.local: See you next time.
dialogue.en: See you next time.
